author: Home Repair Tutor
description: I’m using the Strait-Flex Outlet Patch for this repair. I embed it using setting-type joint compound to speed up the project. This method makes the drywall patch strong and enables the outlet and cover plat to sit flat against the wall. Many thanks to ClarkDietrich for sponsoring this tutorial
